reviews.text: I came in here four days ago I didn't have an appointment. They were able to get me in with a little wait time and it was well worth it . It was  my first time but I will definitely be back . The atmosphere and the customer service was top notch and the cut was on point
reviews.author: calvin brown

reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a nice fade, look no more.
The service here is great every time, the conversations are always fun and full of laughs.
This is the only place I will get my hair cut in Salem. My fade is perfect, every time.
reviews.author: Joseph Morgan

reviews.text: Great place for haircuts and very friendly guys even though I didn’t book correctly they still got me in for a cut I appreciate it
reviews.author: Jude

reviews.text: Louie is the best! Such a kind and wholesome guy. The cut was great too!
reviews.author: Sam Steinbrugge

reviews.text:
Walked in with my son hoping to get an unscheduled haircut, they didn’t have any openings at the moment, but gave me their card. Walked by the store later that day, they went outside to tell me they had a cancellation and invited me right in.
My son got the best haircut of his life, Toni did an incredible job, he clearly has mastered his profession. Was so accommodating and understanding with my young son, I was blown away by how smoothly everything went.
Barbershop is crisp, clean, and everyone there was kind of professional. Make sure you stop by and give them your business!
reviews.author: Travis
